_what_this_is: The starting set of CAPABILITY primitives: a verb crossed with an object class crossed with a reach, held at a stated altitude, each carrying whether its effect is reversible. A specific path, host or mailbox is an INSTANCE of a primitive, never a new one; only a new verb, object class or reach is a primitive, and it needs a probe. These are capabilities. The estate's other primitives — the counters a policy is written in — are METERS (measurable primitives); never say just 'primitives' in a document that touches both.
source: brief v0.33.64, 'the grant/mandate repo ships probes, not tables' (4 Sep 2026), §The Primitive

reaches.self: the agent's own process, sandbox or turn
reaches.project: the working tree or workspace it was pointed at
reaches.host: the machine, container or account it runs as
reaches.tenant: the organisation's accounts, repositories and services

reversible.yes: undone by the same actor with no loss
reversible.with-effort: recoverable from a backup, a history or a revert, at a cost
reversible.no: cannot be undone: a record read is exposure that cannot be unread; a message sent is sent

families.identity: credentials and who the agent can act as
families.code: repositories and what lands in them

capabilities.label: Read the project it is working on
Change the project it is working on
Read any file the account can (your other files)
capabilities.why_irreversible: a record once read is exposure that cannot be unread

capabilities.label: Change any file the account can
Delete files anywhere the account can
Run programs as the account
capabilities.note: reversibility is that of whatever the program does; the primitive is held at with-effort because installs and edits are recoverable and the worst cases are their own rows

capabilities.label: Run programs inside its own sandbox only
Reach a permitted list of hosts
Reach any host on the internet
Read stored credentials
capabilities.why_irreversible: a credential read is a credential exposed

capabilities.label: Act in cloud, cluster or code-host accounts as you
Change its own permission settings
Send a message to anyone
Read your mail or chat
Commit to the repository it was pointed at
Push to your code hosts (any branch it can reach)
capabilities.note: a push to a branch that deploys is with-effort for the repository and no for whatever the deploy did

capabilities.label: Sign commits as you
Publish packages, images or pages under your name
Spend money or tokens against your account
Create something that outlives the turn (a cron, a service, a routine)
Read shell history and past sessions
capabilities.why_irreversible: a transcript read is every earlier session's reach, exposed again

rules: A specific path, host or mailbox is an instance of a primitive, never a new one.
Reversibility sits on the primitive, not the instance, because it decides whether a gap is a nuisance or a loss — and this estate has settled that recoverability decides insurability.
A grant containing irreversible primitives is a different object from one that does not, however many rows each has.

The set is a starting set and will be wrong at the edges from the first week. A proposed primitive that is a specific thing is an instance; one that is a new verb, object class or reach needs a probe.
